dogecoin.text: The US G O V has zero dollars invested in #Dogecoin so of course they would use their media to try to downplay a growing coin by asking if it’s a hustle, yea sure with a 600+ million trading volume that grew more than Ethereum has currently. 🧠🤦🏾‍♂️

#DOGECOIN is not a “hustle”, I promise you, keep listening to American media if you want, the coin is being traded internationally whether the US G O V likes it or not. They want you to focus more on Bitcoin so their supply of coins from a lower share price can be worth more. 🧠

The problem is that the same rich investors of #Bitcoin who wish not to see a more feasible coin such as #Dogecoin be great, use their investments to crash the party for the little people, making most of them more skeptical to what they already didn’t understand.

#Dogecoin is a little more than 1/100,000th of the price of #Bitcoin. Let that sink in, if Doge became the consumers coin instead of the investors coin, we can simultaneously have another currency coexist for day to day transactions.
